During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this '''[[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]''' served with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Lock]]. He was among the members of [[Horn Company]] on board the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']].

==Biography==
This [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] served under Captain Lock and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Eeth Koth]] as part of [[Horn Company]]. When Koth's [[cruiser]] was attacked and boarded, he instantly took action. He rushed towards the General's quarters and fired at the incoming [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] and [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]]. This trooper was soon overwhelmed and rendered unconscious. However, when Koth was hit by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt and about to be killed, the trooper gunned down the droid, saving Koth's life.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Moments after blasting the droid, a Magnaguard electrocuted the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] from behind, leaving Koth to attempt to fight off the advancing droids.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />
